snippet.title: Female Lead LGBTQ+ Visual Novel Soulcake Demo PV on Steam NOW
snippet.description:
Two-person indie studio proudly presents SOULCAKE (Amare) — a dark fantasy female-led GL/F4A romance visual novel with branching stories & 13 unique endings!

📌 DEMO INFORMATION
• 1 hour playable free demo already live on Itch.io
• Steam demo launching soon! Wishlist the game to get notified
• Demo features: All 3 romance route openings, 30k word script, 4 explorable maps

📌 FULL GAME ROADMAP
• 13 distinct story endings
• 200,000 full in-game script
• Over 100 original CG illustrations
• 15 explorable dark fantasy locations

✨ Game Themes & Tags
Female protagonist, GL / Yuri romance, F4A (four-way love dynamic), dark fantasy, LGBTQ+ core storytelling, mild suggestive visuals, branching narrative, multiple endings

We’re actively recruiting native translators for English, Japanese, Korean & Spanish!
If you’re interested in localizing our VN, check the recruitment page via the link pinned in comments / link in description below.

🔗 LINKS
🎮Itch.io Demo: https://roomofonesroom.itch.io/soulcake
💖Steam Store Page (Wishlist Here): https://store.steampowered.com/app/4792160/Soulcake/?beta=1
💬Translator Recruitment Form: https://itch.io/jam/otome-jam-2026/topic/6564594/native-enjpkres-speakers-wanted

#VisualNovel #YuriVN #GLRomance
If you love emotional dark fantasy lesbian romance games, hit LIKE & SUBSCRIBE for full game updates, CG previews and new story clips!
Drop a comment below which romance route you want to play first~
